records.text: Erika Frantzve says she lived in Chongqing, China, as well as Puerto Rico, and had traveled to Romania and Croatia.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: I've lived in China. I've lived in Chongqing. I've been to Romania. I've been in Croatia. Lived in Puerto Rico for a little bit. Really handsome.

verification.notes: The audition recording directly documents that Erika said she had lived in Chongqing and Puerto Rico and visited Romania and Croatia. Romania travel is independently corroborated, and her then-boyfriend's China and Puerto Rico teams provide context, but reliable records do not establish every claimed residence and trip.
